name: @lacspace/monorepo
description: Lacspace open-source TypeScript packages — platform SDK, Nepal toolkit, React hooks and the StockKit trading suite.

scripts.build: npm -w @lacspace/api run build && npm -w @lacspace/auth run build && npm -w @lacspace/analytics run build && npm -w @lacspace/sdk run build
scripts.build:new: npm -w @lacspace/nepali-date run build && npm -w @lacspace/nepali-utils run build && npm -w @lacspace/react run build
scripts.build:stock: npm -w @lacspace/indicators run build && npm -w @lacspace/market run build && npm -w @lacspace/market-clock run build && npm -w @lacspace/paper-trade run build
scripts.publish:stock: npm -w @lacspace/indicators publish --access public && npm -w @lacspace/market publish --access public && npm -w @lacspace/market-clock publish --access public && npm -w @lacspace/paper-trade publish --access public
